R4878.summary: Queen Anne's instructions to the Earl of Peterborough: the coded passages hide his real errand, to meet the Electoral Prince of Saxony (the future Augustus III) on his way to Rome to abjure Protestantism, urge him to remain Protestant and, if he wished to flee, concert his rescue to England or another Protestant state, under cover of a visit to Rome.

system: A numerical English code of groups 76-2269 with many nulls and some homophones, used for the sensitive phrases inside clear instructions.
